output.summary: An annual flowering plant indigenous to the high Peruvian Andes, love-lies-bleeding is known for striking, dense flower clusters that may be black, red or, most commonly, white. Its leaves and seeds are edible; the seeds are eaten as cereal, popped or ground into flour.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves and seeds are edible; seeds are popped, eaten as cereal, or ground into flour for breads, sweets, pasta and noodles.
